title: Wake path
summary: A case's wake_path is automatic (default: starts when its stage begins, and the stage driver wakes the member's owner) or manual (its owner is woken to confirm wake_evidence before running it). Manual needs a one-line wake_evidence naming real-traffic evidence a registered read can confirm; authoring refuses wake_evidence_required, wake_evidence_without_manual_wake, wake_path_invalid or wake_evidence_not_one_line. For a member with an open manual case the stage driver sends one push_notice per open manual requirement instead of the ordinary stage wake: check the evidence with a registered read, run the member's cases if it exists, otherwise ask the operator for a waiver. A parked holder is woken; a holder-less member reaches the project steering seat. The steering fleet report lists each under 'waiting on manual wake' with evidence, owner and run command. A live requirement is marked with yoke qa requirement update, wake_evidence first, then wake_path.
